description: List all paid campaigns synced from a provider (meta, google, or tiktok). Call this to discover campaignId values — you need a campaignId to call insights or ad group tools. Returns campaign IDs, names, statuses, objectives, and budgets. Use the returned campaignId values with nevent_get_paid_campaign_insights and nevent_list_paid_ad_groups.
name: nevent_list_paid_campaigns
